Docs PR #238 at 68cc34c29b8f8609b0b3e4db7f659112672f052f: reviewer block on P2 F238-001, canonical blueprint contract lag relative to #239 fe6811f6. Missing status type/epoch-ms/null rules, failure-state mapping, reload refetch recovery, failed-refresh latch, independent 402 latch/recovery, upstream redirects off, and the 60-second failed-check cache/rate. Exact canonical-field edits are in the verdict.

Positive proof: all 14 requirements have testable done_when/matrix mappings covering rows 1-23; all requirements delivered and all 11 components built by s02/s03. s01 complete; parallel s02/s03 depend on s01, s02 merges first; s04 depends on both. Blueprint includes sidecar, memory-only gh token, 401-only refresh, free quota snapshot gate, MODEL_ID/MAX_PROMPT_TOKENS/VISION, and subagent 5m TTL. Credential and listener rules are unchanged from rulings/#239; security may skip this docs-only PR per PM packet.

P3 N238-001: s04 title still says 21 rather than 23, s02 done_when omits new rows 22/23, PR body says 12 rather than 14 requirements, and concise PRD/overview wording should reflect VISION and initiator precedence.

All three ddocs validate commands independently returned 0 errors/0 warnings; CI exact-head run 44225613079 green and pr-freeze FINAL; no build or product edits.

Published writer verdict community/roles/reviewer/outputs/2026-11/18-verdict-pr-238-68cc34c.dd.json (commit 45d475624ba79072120711e0eeec1e52d4b1e2a3), with PR comment 6967907093.

magicWand: after parallel lanes settle a shared API clarification, reconcile its canonical blueprint field with the implementation/plan at the same handoff, rather than relying only on structural link validation.

difficulties: ddocs joins and coverage are all green while the normative status/readiness prose is stale. Treat semantic contract alignment as separate evidence, and provide exact JSON field edits plus generated-face regeneration, not an open-ended request to rewrite docs.
